title: Building a free daily fundamental analysis workflow for Forex
author: Novel-Focus-7538
selftext:
​

I’m interested in building a workflow for Forex fundamental analysis that I can run every day and automatically get a report about what’s happening in the FX market.

Something like:

\- Important economic news and events

\- Central bank decisions and speeches

\- CPI, NFP, GDP, PMI, interest rates, etc.

\- What happened recently and why it matters for currencies

\- Upcoming events that could move the market

\- Bullish/bearish factors for each major currency

\- Overall fundamental sentiment for pairs like EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, etc.

I want to automate as much of this as possible, probably with Python / Google Colab, but I want to keep the whole thing $0 if possible.

What free APIs, data sources, tools, or websites would you recommend for this?

And if you were building this yourself with a $0 budget, how would you structure the workflow?

Any advice is appreciated.
